title: A MOTEL OFF THE 5 — JULY 16, 1988 — 4:12 AM

a.speaker: narration
a.text: She counts them before she sleeps. It used to be sheep.

b.speaker: narration
b.text: Twenty-four at the motel. Nineteen at the yard. Thirty-one on Stage Nine. She always loses count around the bellhop.

c.speaker: cass
c.text: They had guns. They were paid. They'd have done the same to me.

d.speaker: narration
d.text: The television at the foot of the bed stops showing static. It shows a house on a hill, and a banner over the door. WRAP PARTY.

e.speaker: dead
e.text: Everybody's here, Cass. Everybody you invited.

f.speaker: tommy
f.text: Cassie. Come up to the house. We saved you a seat.

g.speaker: narration
g.text: She's standing on the lawn. The graves have gold stars on them. The dirt is still moving.
